title: A database that picks a new leader when one dies
about: A shop's orders live in a database. Here there are three copies. One is the leader and accepts changes; the others copy everything it does. If the leader dies, the copies agree on a new leader and no orders are lost.
tryThis: Stop the box marked leader. Within about 30 seconds another one becomes leader. Then stop pat-etcd and see why the page warns that there is no leader.

roles.pat-etcd: The referee. It decides who the leader is, so two copies never both think they are in charge.
roles.pat-pg1: A copy of the database. It is either the leader or a replica that follows the leader.
roles.pat-pg2: A second copy of the database, with the same job as the first.
roles.pat-pg3: A third copy of the database. With three copies, losing one is not a problem.
